note: Precomputed model outputs, not live generation. Videos contain the shared initial frame followed by every predicted frame, without interpolation. Curated qualitative examples do not replace aggregate test results.
timingNote: A shared initial frame and all future frames are encoded at 4 FPS. 16 s and nominal 4 s prediction horizons produce 16.25 s and 4.25 s media. LuSNAR uses nearest-source sampling; its original nonuniform capture offsets are retained in each sample.

demos.title: Gravel trail
demos.description: A 16-second rollout over uneven outdoor terrain.
demos.protocol: One real initial image repeated into a four-frame context; each predicted RGB image is re-encoded for the next step. Conditioned on the recorded trajectory. Seed 0; DDPM 250 steps for both models.
demos.selection: Qualitative example selected from the archived candidate set after visual review; not a representative aggregate evaluation.
demos.limitations: The generated view retains the outdoor scene but terrain geometry and the precise path drift over time.

conditioningTrajectory.axes: local +x forward, +y left; display up forward, right negative local y

demos.title: Moon 7
demos.model: OpenNWM Nav15 Stage 2, LuSNAR fine-tuned EMA
demos.protocol: Each horizon is predicted from the same four observed context frames and anchor-relative target body pose.
demos.selection: First preselected held-out window in each of Moon_7, Moon_8 and Moon_9; not ranked by prediction quality.
demos.limitations: Qualitative held-out simulated scenes; direct predictions are not a continuous autoregressive rollout. Geometry and long-rollout consistency remain imperfect. Not a validation of physical navigation.

conditioningTrajectory.axes: Forward and left in meters relative to the last observed rover-body pose.
conditioningTrajectory.timeSemantics: Frame 0 is the shared context anchor; frames 1–16 use the paired target pose. Playback is 4 FPS; nonuniform source capture offsets are retained separately.
